lines.en: I set each foot firmly on the ground.
My stone body makes a dull sound.
I circle near my anchor point.
My shoulders are wider than a door.
The soil sinks where I step.
I raise my head to read the terrain.
I turn slowly, joints grinding.
I follow the line of the ore seam.
I lift the stone out of my way.

lines.zh: 我的体重压得土路下陷。
lines.en: My weight sinks the dirt road.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方留有石粉。
lines.en: Stone dust marks where I've been.
I duck through a cave mouth.
My fingers brush the rock wall.
I stop and scent the ore.
I stand like a wall.

lines.zh: 我的身体是岩石拼起来的。
lines.en: My body is assembled from stone.
Minerals are my food.
I wait for my master's word.
Crystal shards stud my fists.
I don't sit. I'm too heavy.
The ore down here is decent.
My name is Gogmamon.
I can be assigned to mine.
I count the cracks on my body.

lines.zh: 我蹲在矿道口，等矿的味道。
lines.en: I crouch at the mine mouth, waiting for the smell of ore.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，也是一种威吓。
lines.en: Standing still is its own threat.
No lungs. Only a stone cavity.

lines.zh: 我把拳头握了一下，石屑落下。
lines.en: I clench a fist; grit falls.

lines.zh: 你的头顶还没到我的胸。
lines.en: Your head doesn't even reach my chest.
How much can you lift?
I'm studying your frame.
There's no ore on you.
One punch of mine will keep you busy.
You mean to fight me?
You're standing in my mine tunnel.
The ground under me is solid.
I mean no harm unless you do.
Why raise your hand?

lines.zh: 我可以走开，也可以不走。
lines.en: I can walk away, or not.
Don't stand where I'm about to step.
You're small. Nimble.

lines.zh: 我的速度比你想象的快。
lines.en: I'm faster than you think.
I've looked at your weapon.
I wait for your decision.
A piece of stone falls off me.
That cracked me.

lines.zh: 一块石头从我肩上掉下。
lines.en: A chunk falls off my shoulder.
I cover my chest with a hand.
A dull echo rolls through my stone chest.
My crystals dim once.
This stone body can still stand.
You hit a joint.
I'll remember this crack.
This will mend.
Is that ore?
Give it. I eat that.
I bend, and my stones grind.
This ore is high grade.
Don't pull that hand back yet.
I grind it fine before swallowing.
A handful of ore only jams my teeth.
Another piece of ore.
After eating I'll be sturdier.
Set it down. I'll pick it up.
Tastier than rock.
I remember this piece.
You hit me and I only sway.
You didn't move me.
My stone knocks you back.
You've stepped on my plate.

lines.zh: 我让开路，石面擦着石面。
lines.en: I step aside, stone scraping stone.
The impact sounds dull.
My weight is here.
Don't press on my joints.

lines.zh: 这一下，我等了一会儿才动。
lines.en: I took a moment to move after that.
Again won't help.
Another stone beast is here.
We touch fists.
Its crystals are brighter than mine.
We dig together.
Our kind need no words.
It watches above for me.
We mark the way with ore.
It leaves first; its steps carry.
Next time, this same seam.
We never fight over ore.
I bend and lift the stone away.
This can be eaten as ore.
I tuck it into a shoulder seam.
I gather the drops.
I pinch it; it crumbles.

lines.zh: 我把它放进背上的凹口。
lines.en: I set it in the hollow on my back.
This won't fill a stone gap.
I pry it out with a knuckle.
I press the pearl under stone.
It makes climbing awkward.
You spoke wrongly. I move.
I raise my fist. That's the signal.
This carries the weight of stone.
Only rock wall left behind you.
I've fixed on your knee.
I'm not quick, but I'm precise.

lines.zh: 你手上那件东西，挡住也没用。
lines.en: Blocking with that won't help.
One stride and I'm before you.
I lift a foot and plant it behind you.
You still have room to yield.
My hand is already over my head.
This is my last warning.
You circle behind the pillar; I follow.
I follow down the mine tunnel.
The cave echoes follow you.
You circle; I follow step by step.
My eyes shine even in the dark.
Hiding only changes which rock.

lines.zh: 你跑的每一步，我都听见。
lines.en: I hear every step you run.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我听得出节奏。
lines.en: I can hear the beat of your heart.
You're at the fork. Narrower there.
I raise a hand to block the ceiling.
You're up there; I look up.
I raise my fist to shoulder height.
My fist falls; the rock splits.
Your shield bends under it.
This one brings all the stone down.
You're driven into the wall.
I shove you from the side.
One shove sends you down the slope.
I drive my bracer across you.
The fist lands and the floor caves.
Grit covers the floor.
I draw my fist back slowly.
I strike your knee.
I've pinned your hand.
I rise out of the rock strata.
Someone spoke my name.
My stone body forms first.
The ore smell underground is strong.
Stone grit sifts from my knuckles.
The cave here is big enough.
When I land, dust falls from the cave roof.
My anchor point is nearby.
First I check the ceiling.
The soil packs under my weight.
I hear someone digging.
I step out of the ore vein.
I'll keep this place.
I settle, like a stone.

lines.zh: 火烤着我的石头，只是发烫。
lines.en: Fire heats my stone. That's all.

lines.zh: 落地时我的腿震得发麻。
lines.en: The landing numbs my legs.

lines.zh: 水灌不进我的身体，可我在沉。
lines.en: Water can't get in, but I sink.

lines.zh: 冲击掀掉了我肩上的一块。
lines.en: The blast breaks a piece off my shoulder.
The arrow strikes and snaps.
Light gets into the cracks and burns.
No ore, and I slow down.

lines.zh: 雷打我身上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits; I shudder once.
I fall, heavy and deep.
